messages:
Mira: Quick sync  new micro-experiment: 'Template Trails' to test whether curated prompt packs + modest credits lift 7-day activation vs credits-only. Need routing, landing variants, benchmarks, and post-claim nudges.
Elena: Love the name. Two arms?
Mira: Yes. Arm A = templates + $15 credits. Arm B = $15 credits only. Also test two landing headlines (developer vs outcome).
Dan: Routing: add hidden field campaign=template_trails_23 and partner_id if present. If email_domain in enterprise_list or company_size>200 -> route to enterprise-sales channel. Pseudo-rule: 
```
if submission.campaign == "template_trails_23":
  if submission.company_size > 200 or submission.email_domain in enterprise_list:
    route = "enterprise-sales"
  else:
    route = "growth-nurture"
  notify = ["#sales-inbound","#growth-inbound"]
```
Priya: Credits gated: require execution verification (server ping when user runs example). Only grant credits after verification job. We'll add template_id and partner_id to the lead payload.
Leo: Ops: expect spike 24-72h post-launch. Schedule SDR rotation and enable an "high-intent" Slack digest to avoid noisy alerts.
Elena: Measurement: primary KPI = % who make >=1 API call within 24h. Secondary = day-7 reuse of templates, median tokens/session, 14-day conversion. Need UTM/session flags to attribute correctly.
Mira: Comms plan: LinkedIn post + targeted email + partner co-mail. A/B test two email subject lines: A) "Ship an LLM flow in 20 minutes" B) "Try 5 production prompt templates + credits". Landing copy variants: technical-first vs impact-first.
Dan: Partner links format: https://redwood.ai/trails?pid=partnerX&utm_source=partner&utm_campaign=template-trails. Can we auto-tag partner leads in SFDC?
Priya: Yes  partner_id flows into payload -> SFDC mapping. I'll add webhook to push enterprise leads with tag 'template_trails'.
growth-bot: Playbook created: /playbooks/template-trails (status: draft)
Mira: Tasks: Elena -> copy + social assets by Tue. Priya -> form + verification + routing PR by Wed. Dan -> SFDC mapping + partner link tests by Wed. Leo -> SDR schedule + Slack digest by Thu. I'll own dashboard + launch calendar.
Elena: I'll include 2 headline variants: "Build usable LLM features in minutes" and "5 production-ready templates to get product-market fit faster".
Priya: PR target Wed AM, include automated tests for verification job.
Mira: Quick poll: launch week May 17 (:one:) or May 24 (:two:). React.
Elena: :one:
Dan: :two: (leaning but flexible)
Leo: :one:
Mira: Going with May 17. I'll send invites + playbook link. Thanks team!
